Captured by the retired M1 shell lab in CI (GitHub ubuntu-24.04 runner, nftables 1.0.9,
kernel in `kernel.txt`). WireGuard public keys are replaced by `PUBKEY<n>`; `case-NN` names
match the lab cases. Regenerate from the `lab-captures` artifact of a lab run.
These captures predate ADR 0032 and do not include the post-NAT egress chain.
